title: Fish Wrap Biryani
description: A flavorful and spicy Indian-inspired dish made with fish, rice, and spices. A perfect combination of flavors and textures.

ingredients.name: Fish
ingredients.notes: Any firm white fish works well

ingredients.name: Rice
ingredients.notes: Basmati or jasmine rice works best

instructions: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add 1 tsp of oil and sauté the fish until cooked through.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tsp of oil and sauté the cumin and garam masala.
Add the rice to the pan and stir to combine with the spices.
Add 2 cups of water to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-12 minutes, or until the rice is cooked.
Fluff the cooked rice with a fork and set aside.
Warm the tortilla wraps by wrapping them in a damp cloth and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the biryani by placing a portion of the cooked rice on a tortilla, followed by a portion of the cooked fish, and garnishing with cilantro and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Repeat the layers 3-4 times, finishing with a layer of rice on top.
Wrap the biryani tightly in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Cut the biryani into individual servings and serve immediately.
